_readme: Default configs for scripts/chunk_embed_bench.py — an OFFLINE chunk x embedder x
reranker recall benchmark. No LightRAG, no ingest, no LLM extraction: chunk the
documents, embed chunks and questions, rank by cosine, optionally rerank, and check
whether each probe's gold evidence quote is in the top-k chunks.
Run it on the Thinkpad, where the corpus is. Nothing here reads the store:
.venv/bin/python scripts/chunk_embed_bench.py \
--corpus ~/rag-project/probe/loop_corpus.json \
--probes ~/rag-project/probe/solvay-dev-v1.jsonl ~/rag-project/probe/solvay-heldout-v1.jsonl \
--out ~/rag-project/probe/chunk-bench \
--configs docs/ops/loop/chunk-embed-bench-configs.json \
--embed-url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --api-key-env OMLX_API_KEY \
--rerank-url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --rerank-model jina-reranker-v3 \
--compare mxbai-recursive-350 current-1200-100-mxbai
The script refuses an --embed-url or --rerank-url on port 9621 (LightRAG) or 8020
(gateway): it talks to the model server, never to the stack under production use.
Why these arms (docs/research/decision-embed-rerank-chunk.md, section 1):
mxbai-embed-large-v1 has a real 512-token window and truncates silently, so today's
1200/100 chunks are roughly 57% invisible to vector search. The primary recommendation
is recursive 350/50 with Latin sentence separators on the CURRENT embedder; BGE-M3
(8192-token window, served by oMLX) is the upgrade option, tested here at the same
sizes so the embedder and the chunk size are separate questions.
Set the model ids to exactly what oMLX reports for each endpoint. "bge-m3" is the
family name, not necessarily the served id; if the served id differs, edit these arms
before running, because the embedding cache key includes the model name.
Sanity check before trusting anything: the corpus is 108 chunks at 1200/100 in
production (Hermes' count). current-1200-100-mxbai should land within a few percent of
that. If it does not, the local chunkers are approximating badly - compare configs
against each other and do not quote absolute chunk counts.
The two +rerank arms are placeholders for "the best two": after the first pass, swap
their chunker block for the two arms that led, so the reranker is measured against its
own baseline rather than against a guess.
tiktoken is not installed in this venv, so runs here report
tokenizer=whitespace-fallback and their token counts are optimistic. Install tiktoken
on the Thinkpad (or pass --tokenizer tiktoken to fail loudly) before using the token
percentiles as a 512-token-window argument.
max_input_tokens on an embedder is not sent to the server: it is the declared real
window, used only to report over_embedder_window_pct - how many chunks are already
bigger than the model can see. That number is the whole point of the first arm.

configs.name: current-1200-100-mxbai
configs._note: What production does today. The control: over_embedder_window_pct here is the size of the truncation problem.

configs.name: mxbai-fixed-350
configs._note: Same embedder, embedder-sized chunks, token-window cutting kept (it can split a word). Overlap held at 50 so the only difference from mxbai-recursive-350 is the strategy.

configs.name: mxbai-recursive-350
configs._note: Recommendation 1A: 350/50 on the current embedder, separators chosen so transcript speaker turns stay whole and a long unpunctuated STT paragraph falls through to sentence boundaries.

configs.name: bge-m3-recursive-350
configs._note: Same chunking as 1A, different embedder: isolates the model from the chunk size.

configs.name: bge-m3-recursive-600-80
configs._note: BGE-M3 can actually see these, so the size curve is meaningful: 600, 800 and 1200 are unreadable by mxbai and fully readable here.

configs.name: bge-m3-recursive-1200-100
configs._note: Production chunk size with an embedder that fits it. If this beats 350, chunk size was never the problem - the embedder window was.

configs.name: mxbai-recursive-350+rerank
configs._note: Reranker on top of the leading candidate: cosine picks top_n_in=40 candidates, /v1/rerank reorders them, metrics are recomputed on the new order.

configs.name: bge-m3-recursive-350+rerank
configs._note: Reranker on the upgrade path. Compare against bge-m3-recursive-350 to price the reranker alone.
